items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And so we'd get up there... Tommy Ladnier said, you know something, Bash, he say, you the dead image of Beethoven.

ctx.x: And so we'd get up there and they had a professional hobo used to do the shopping for us. And we used to cook and everything you know. And one day we were having dinner and they had a big picture of Beethoven right up on the wall, see. And Tommy Ladnier said, you know something, Bash, he say, you the dead image of Beethoven. (LAUGHTER).
And you never did hear no jazz in there. Nothing but just the Swdn Song!
